build: iceberg-datafusion 0.10.1, datafusion 53.1.0, iceberg 0.10.1, iceberg-catalog-rest 0.10.1, iceberg-storage-opendal 0.10.1, opendal 0.57.0, reqwest 0.12.28

catalog-login.note: iceberg-catalog-rest builds reqwest without a TLS backend, so an https catalog needs a direct reqwest 0.12 dependency with rustls-tls (apache/iceberg-rust#2888)

incremental-read.note: iceberg-rust, which iceberg-datafusion is built on, scans one snapshot only (TableScanBuilder::snapshot_id) and has no incremental append scan; reads between snapshot ids are open in apache/iceberg-rust#2152 (PR #2997)

views.note: iceberg-rust, which iceberg-datafusion is built on, has no Iceberg view support (apache/iceberg-rust#55)
